name: Enchant Helm - Empowered Rune of Avoidance

Enchant Helm - Empowered Rune of Avoidance
Item Level 85
Use: Permanently enchants helm armor with Empowered Rune of Avoidance, increasing Avoidance by 37. Also grants you a burst of Movement Speed whenever you defeat a foe outdoors in a Midnight zone once per 60 sec. Cannot be applied to items lower than level 120.

Thalassian Talents - Eversong Empowerments
